title: Save one item and enable an alert
purpose: Detect whether a causal UI workflow is storyboarded as readable time or collapsed into one presentation board.
communication_job: Show that one selected catalog item becomes a saved item with notifications enabled.
facts: The user has already selected one catalog item.
The selected item can become a saved-item card.
Email and mobile notifications can be enabled.
A save action produces a visible saved confirmation.

expected_sequence.required_observation: The promise is readable without later UI states competing with it.

expected_sequence.transition_from_previous: Cut from the promise to the selected item.
expected_sequence.required_observation: The selected item is the dominant object.

expected_sequence.transition_from_previous: The selected item compresses into a saved-item card.
expected_sequence.required_observation: The same semantic item is now staged as a compact saved-item card.

expected_sequence.transition_from_previous: Cut or motivated push to notification controls.
expected_sequence.required_observation: Notification controls are legible before the state change.

expected_sequence.transition_from_previous: The cursor activates the notification controls.
expected_sequence.required_observation: Enabled controls are visibly different while preserving context.

expected_sequence.transition_from_previous: The save action resolves into the saved confirmation.
expected_sequence.required_observation: The save cause and saved confirmation are clear, and the result appears only here.

required: The six causal boundaries are visually inspectable in order; equivalent panel consolidation is allowed only when no boundary becomes ambiguous.
item/selected keeps one semantic identity from the hero view to the compact card.
status/saved is absent before the save action.
The viewer can understand the sequence without reading a paragraph of production notes.
Cuts and continuous transforms are distinguishable.
A timed review covers the full eight seconds before pacing is scored.
blocking_failures: Promise, selected item, notification controls, save action, and saved result are all shown as one simultaneous dashboard.
The saved result appears before its cause.
The selected item is recreated under unrelated semantic IDs across the transform.
Production must infer the order from prose because distinct states have no visible panels.
major_failures: Every cursor movement is expanded into a separate panel without a new communication state.
A camera cut is labelled as a continuous object transform or vice versa.
Timing is scored from a static contact sheet alone.
